summary: Donegal Group Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the release date for its third-quarter 2026 results. The company will report results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Thursday, October 29, 2026 before the NASDAQ open, with a supplemental investor presentation posted concurrently. A pre-recorded webcast with CEO Kevin Burke, CFO Jeffrey Miller and senior management will be available at approximately 8:30 am EDT the same day, with pre-submitted questions due by October 15. No special-situation transaction, terms, advisors or board recommendation are involved.
